nameForms.name: Duchy of Normandy
nameForms.note: The Norman principality, conventionally dated from Rollo's settlement in 911 until Philip II's conquest of mainland Normandy.
nameForms.noteCn: 诺曼底的诺曼公国，通常自罗洛于 911 年受封定居起，至腓力二世征服诺曼底大陆止。

holders.titleForm: Count of Rouen / Duke of Normandy
holders.note: Rollo, founder of the Norman principality.
holders.noteCn: 罗洛，诺曼公国的奠基者。

holders.titleForm: Count of Rouen / Duke of Normandy

holders.note: Richard I the Fearless consolidated the duchy.
holders.noteCn: 无畏者理查一世巩固了诺曼底公国。

holders.note: Succeeded Richard II; his reign was brief.
holders.noteCn: 继承理查二世；在位时间很短。

holders.note: Robert Curthose, displaced after the Battle of Tinchebray.
holders.noteCn: 罗贝尔·柯索斯，廷什布赖战役后失去公国。

holders.note: Seized Normandy from his brother Robert Curthose in 1106.
holders.noteCn: 1106 年从其兄罗贝尔·柯索斯手中取得诺曼底。

holders.note: Stephen held Normandy during the first phase of the Anarchy, until Rouen fell to Geoffrey V.
holders.noteCn: 内战初期斯蒂芬控制诺曼底，直至鲁昂落入杰弗里五世之手。

holders.note: Geoffrey V conquered Normandy and ceded it to his son Henry.
holders.noteCn: 杰弗里五世征服诺曼底，后将其让与儿子亨利。

holders.note: Henry II held Normandy before becoming king of England.
holders.noteCn: 亨利二世在成为英格兰国王前即持有诺曼底。

holders.note: John was the last Plantagenet duke before Philip II's conquest of mainland Normandy.
holders.noteCn: 约翰是腓力二世征服诺曼底大陆前最后一位金雀花王朝诺曼底公爵。

holders.note: Mainland Normandy was incorporated into the French royal domain; no autonomous duke followed.
holders.noteCn: 诺曼底大陆并入法国王室领地，此后不再有自治公爵。
